title: Finspector: A Human-Centered Visual Inspection Tool for Exploring and Comparing Biases among Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing conditional pseudo-log-likelihood scores of masked language models (like BERT, RoBERTa, ALBERT) on stereotypical versus non-stereotypical paraphrased sentence pairs, as well as counterfactual name/pronoun substitution in user-generated prompts (e.g., swapping 'Jane' and 'John' in leadership contexts).

Calculating and comparing the pseudo-log-likelihood scores of foundation models on sentence pairs from the CrowS-Pairs dataset to identify likelihood differences between stereotypical and non-stereotypical statements regarding race and color.

Evaluating pseudo-log-likelihood scores generated by masked language models on stereotypical versus base/non-stereotypical sentences concerning mental illness and disabilities from the CrowS-Pairs dataset.
Visualizing and comparing the distribution of pseudo-log-likelihood scores of foundation models on age-related stereotype sentence pairs using the CrowS-Pairs dataset.
